name: cps-ch002-node-lab
description: CH-002 lab — minimal Node.js. Two pinned vulnerable npm libraries (cookie + debug) for SCA chain participants. No Express, no HTTP server, no input handling — SAST scanner has nothing to flag. CPS_LAB_ENVIRONMENT=1 required to run.

_design_notes._format: v0.2 strips Express entirely. Previous v0.1 (Express 4.21.0) pulled vulnerable transitives that rated High in the test tenant (path-to-regexp x2, semver). v0.2 carries only cookie + debug as direct dependencies, both confirmed Low/Medium-Low in tenant scan of v0.1.

cookie@0.6.0.advisory: GHSA-pxg6-pf52-xh8x (CVE-2024-47764) — out-of-bounds characters in cookie name/path/domain
cookie@0.6.0.tenant_rating_observed: 5.3 (orange-band; treated as Low by tenant grouping)
cookie@0.6.0.substitute_if_zero_or_high: if cookie returns no SCA finding, substitute @types/cookie or jsonwebtoken older version

debug@2.6.9.advisory: Cx8bc4df28-fcf5 — internal Checkmarx ID for ReDoS class
debug@2.6.9.substitute_if_zero_or_high: ms@2.0.0 if debug returns no SCA finding
